verdict.comment: Andrew Balding is in flying form and his new recruit WILTSHIRE LAD gets the vote ahead of Hot Dancer and Invited.

comments.castlestuart: 1m maiden winner last year; can't have been right last time; yard won this 12 months ago
comments.hotdancer: Promising at two and potential improver in handicaps for yard which does well in this race
comments.invited: Arrives on a hat-trick after two AW wins; 6lb rise demands more improvement, but respected
comments.ourmightymo: Two nursery wins last year but more exposed than some in this field; has been gelded
comments.thunderwonder: Novice win last year; creditable third on recent AW reappearance
comments.wedaretodream: Progressive at 6f/7f as 2yo and there should be more to come this year; likely to stay 1m
comments.wiltshirelad: Won AW nursery on final start for Sir Michael Stoute and likely more to come for new yard
comments.zowal: Ex-French; won C&D maiden for new yard 17 days ago; more needed from opening mark of 84

races.raceComment: invited is marginally preferred with a score of 47.1%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and superior course form and more progressive over ourmightymo. Won 2 of last 5 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.intinso: Plenty of ability on first two runs for new yard but latest (February) was less positive

comments.lapulga: In the form of his life over 1m3f-1m6f in the autumn but better still will be required
comments.laafy: Absent 1373 days when well beaten for new yard three weeks ago; now tries cheekpieces.
comments.lieberpower: Close 2nd at York Ebor meeting (2lb higher today) when he once again finished with gusto
comments.loughville: Flowered last term, most notably for a stylish 1m4f win at Newbury (soft) in September
comments.struth: Last season was disappointing but he's too well handicapped to be totally dismissed

comments.eldoradoallen: The season started well but his form has cooled and now has to stage a revival
comments.flicouvoyou: Up 9lb for winning so well at Newcastle last time but he's on top of his game again
comments.glynn: Could be well-in with Numitor; tough task last time and could feature back from a break
comments.lemilos: Won a qualifier for this in Feb and subsequent defeats have come against younger rivals
comments.numitor: Won this last year; career-high mark after 5lb rise for Ascot but he did win well
comments.spyglasshill: Perhaps unfortunate not to beat The Widdow Maker at Exeter as he made a bad mistake
comments.theflierbegley: Beaten about 10l behind Dubai Days here last time and he's off an untouched mark
comments.thewiddowmaker: All out to win at Exeter but only 2lb higher and historically well handicapped
comments.whistleinthedark: Looks held by a handful of these based on his last couple of runs

Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 8 wins from 32 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 9/35 at haydock. verdict.comment: Recent C&D winner COCONUT TWIST has slower ground this time but he's won twice on soft previously and looks the one to beat.

comments.barricane: Quiet until back to form in first-time blinkers (3m2f, soft); needs blinkers to work again
comments.christopherwood: Smart in his prime but in poor form over fences; first hurdle run for 3 years
comments.coconuttwist: Has won on soft; best form for recent wins at 2m7f (good to firm) and 3m2f (good)
comments.copshilllad: Winning yard debut on soft; back to form latest (2m7f, good); needs more
comments.despereaux: Won twice over 3m in December; not on his game latest; query about soft ground
comments.krugerpark: Not up to big rise in weights for 2m4f win last March; pulled up latest; trip query
comments.moonset: Stayed on for close 2nd in 2m7f maiden, then won over 2m4f; handicap debutant; improve
comments.ricketybridge: Suited by soft ground; below best on good latest but has his conditions again
comments.rockadenn: Acts on soft; creditable first 3m run latest; needs more for this greater test
comments.strikingapose: Latest win over 2m7f last February; down weights but still having a slow season

verdict.comment: Irish challenger GATSBY CAP is a fascinating contender given that he has dropped to a handy mark and the stable is 2-2 here this month.

comments.billymcgarry: C&D winner bidding for a hat-trick; drawn wide but still respected in his current mood
comments.dappledlight: Off six months since winning over 9.5f here; has won fresh before; shortlisted
comments.enzosangel: Both wins have come over 9.5f here; dropping back in trip may no bad thing; thereabouts
comments.gatsbycap: Irish stable is 2-2 here this month; much respected, all the more so if backed
comments.genta: 0-8; some promise last autumn but hasn't built on it; best watched for now
comments.juancooldude: 0-10, but only just beaten over C&D last October; each-way claims if able to repeat that
comments.kingofthedance: First and third over C&D late last month; another big run seems likely
comments.mykonosstjohn: 9lb below last winning mark but will need to improve on recent efforts; blinkers on
comments.northbound: Made a winning return from six months off at Southwell in February, but not built on it
comments.olympicquest: Form has been up and down since winning over C&D early last year; opposable on balance
comments.rebelcove: Well held in three AW novices; major improvement needed on handicap debut
comments.wyvern: Still 1lb below last winning mark but form since has been patchy; not sure what to expect

races.raceComment: billymcgarry is marginally preferred with a score of 55.5%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and better suited by conditions over dappledlight. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Low draws advantaged around tight left-handed polytrack

verdict.comment: An entry in the 2,000 Guineas suggests that JOLLY ROGER is well regarded by the Crisford stable and he can defy a penalty on his return.

comments.arundel: Form of last month's 1m Southwell race modest and vulnerable is this much stronger race
comments.bowfell: Bred to have a future but he'll need to be very useful to make a winning start here
comments.jollyroger: Ready winner at Kempton in December and holds an entry in the 2,000 Guineas
comments.kentuckyriver: Promise over 1m2f/1m3f at end of 2024 but best watched over much shorter on return
comments.kilima: With an excellent yard so a betting check required on debut
comments.redsand: Off since ready Goodwood success last May but still potentially useful
comments.redsandwolves: Well-held fifth on C&D debut 12 days ago; needs to have come on a lot
comments.skibo: Promise over 7f/1m on turf last year; has been gelded; almost certainly has more to offer
comments.skyler: Sold cheaply from James Tate since never invovled on 6f debut last month
comments.warriormode: Should have more to come on the back of C&D debut win last month
comments.waverider: Showed when reaching frame twice on turf as a juvenile; more to come in 2025
comments.zerozero: More one for the longer term judged on last month's 7f Kempton debut

races.raceComment: warriormode is marginally preferred with a score of 30.0%. Excellent course form of 1/1 at wolverhampton. Key attributes include improving, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Despite a 7lb higher mark it's hard to oppose SLOWDOWNBARNEY (nap), who scored by nearly 5l over C&D this month.

comments.blacksmoke: Three of his four wins have come over C&D; bit more needed if he is to resume winning ways
comments.emaculatesoldier: Has regressed in four outings for this yard and now 0-8; stamina still not proven
comments.grandduchessolga: Back off her last winning mark and has been mainly consistent since then; could go well
comments.laserfocus: Unplaced in eight starts on AW and last four efforts on artificial surfaces have been poor
comments.moonoverthesea: Five wins around here including over this trip last time; only 2lb higher; shortlisted
comments.paymentplan: Did well over 16.5f on Tapeta after November; modest the last twice; needs to bounce back
comments.slowdownbarney: 7lb higher than when winning easily over C&D last time, but should still be hard to beat

races.raceComment: moonoverthesea is marginally preferred with a score of 56.4%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over grandduchessolga. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 5 wins from 24 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

comments.radiantangel: Running well over C&D in recent starts; needs some luck but he's capable of a big run
comments.saffredi: 2-2 over C&D and did well to dominate from stall 12 last time; 3lb rise manageable
comments.southbank: Consistent on AW this winter and no obvious reason why he wouldn't make another bold bid
comments.stoneacregirl: 12-race maiden; snippets of form but drawn widest on stable debut
